translation.name: Moppiyon Dinoggan, Moka-atag ki Disas Krays

book.name: JUAN
book.title: Dos Moppiyon Dinoggan no id Sulat ni JUAN

content: Id Doddasan si Disas to Pomammut
Na, annom no allow to waa pa id inguma iddos pista to Kodlihad to Ponolihan, mid undiyon si Disas to Betania no riyon en id ubpa si Lazaro no id badnow rin.
Duwon id panoy ran no lavung atag ki Disas. Na, si Marta kos id sondad kandan woy sokkad taddot mid ka‑an duma ki Disas, si Lazaro.

Si Maria mandad, id angoy to tongngot litru no pomammut no oray'n mahaa. Iddon pomammut, binovallan pomot pinomuwa nod ngoranan to nardo. Id daddas din idda riyot pa‑a ni Disas woy id punasan din to bowvuut uu rin. Na, no‑ompon to mammut iddos intirut baoy.
Piru sokkad taddot mgo tinodduwan ni Disas no si Judas Iscariote no od boligya kandin diyot mori, id sawoy rin si Maria.
Kahi rin to, “Kuu, konuhun! Maanmaan
kos kontidad duwon! Mambo moho to waa id boligya ikon pomammut woy dos bayad, id boggoy riyot mgo worowora?”
Waa rin osenga idda pomon to duwon ginawa rin nod tavang to mgo worowora, ko konna, pomon to tokawon sikandin. Oyyos sikandin man kos tohodsomad to soopi ran woy nooyami rin en nod loliyam tadda.
Piru kahin Disas to, “Podtohona row ron sikandin, su id panoy rin inin pomammut atag to allow't kodlobbong koddi.
Iddos mgo worowora, inaayun dow od koruma. Piru siyak, konna a nikiyu inaayun od koruma.”
Dos Puhawang to Kod‑imatoy ki Lazaro
To norinog to mo‑uraan Judio no riyon don si Disas to Betania, mid undiyon sikandan amoy od kokita ran si Disas woy si Lazaro nid badnow rin.
De‑en iddos mgo ponguu to tohodbuwis, id pomuhawang no od imotayan dan mandad si Lazaro.
Oyyos pomon to kodbadnow kandin, mo‑uraa ron kos mgo duma ran no Judio no worad id posakup kandan, su id pomakoy ron ki Disas.
Id Posivontuhan si Disas to mgo Minuvu to Kod‑inguma Rin diyot Jerusalem
Na so‑op no allow, iddos mo‑uraan minuvu nid sakup taddon pista, nokorinog no od inguma ron si Disas diyot Jerusalem.
De‑en mid angoy ran to mgo lokkoy to palmera
woy id leggua ran diyot bonuwa amoy'd tommu kandin. Pomon to dakkoon kahaan dan, id pehes dan no mid ungketen to,

content.text: Od posivontuhan ta kos id popiyod to Monama nod Longaggon!
Od doongon ta iddos Hari to Israel!”

content: Na, nokita ni Disas no duwon natit asnu woy idda en kos id sokayan din. Ukit taddot id puungan din, notuman iddos no‑ikahi riyot Nosulat no Kahit Monama no mid ungketen to,

content.text: Ontongngi row man, od inguma ron kos hari row no id sakoy to natit asnu.”

content: To iddon timpu, waa pa nokaabbot iddos mgo tinodduwan din to kohulugan tadda. To novadnow woy novatun don si Disas, idda pa sikandan nokosampot no iddos id puungan dan kandin, idda vos en kos no‑ikahi riyot Nosulat no Kahit Monama.
Na, iddos mo‑uraan minuvu nid duma ki Disas no nokokita taddot kod‑umow woy kodbadnow rin ki Lazaro riyot lovongngan, id poso‑ob dan pe‑en tid ponudtuu iddon notomanan.
Idda en kos unayan no mo‑uraan minuvu kos mid tommu ki Disas, oyyos nokorinog dan man taddot mokososoobbun id puungan din.
De‑en id po‑ikohiyoy iddos mgo Pariseo to, “Ontongngi row man, worad id pokogaha ta, su iddos langun no minuvu, id dumoruma ron kandin!”
Dos mgo Griego nod Nangkap ki Disas
Na, duwon mandad mgo Griego no id pon‑undiyot Jerusalem amoy od simba to Monama timpu to pista.
Id porani sikandan ki Felipe no toho Betsaida no sakup to Galilea. Kahi ran to, “Sir, id kopi‑i roy nanoy nod pokidkita ki Disas.”
De‑en mid undiyon si Felipe woy id ponudtulan din si Andres taddot id kopi‑i to mgo Griego, woy id porumannoy ran amoy od ponudtulan si Disas.
Na mid ikahi si Disas kandan to, “Id inguma ron kos timpu no siyak no Anak to Minuvu, od posivontuhon ukit to kopotayan ku.

Bonnaavonnaa nod ikohiyon ku koniyu, no otik dii id pomuwa iddos songo‑ngipon no bonni, dii en idda od tuvu woy diid mo‑uraa. Piru otik id pomuwa idda, iling tid patoy woy id lobbong, od tuvu en idda woy'd mo‑uraa. Na iling mandad tadda, otid patoy ad, od kovadnow a woy'd pokovoggoy to lammin umuu riyot mo‑uraan minuvu.

Dos minuvu no iyon din da en id konuhuni iddos umuu rin, od koworan da en baling tadda. Piru iddos minuvu no diid konuhunan to umuu rin ka‑ay to ampow't ingod atag koddi, od pokotanggap to umuun waad tomanon.
Iddos ahad ondoy nod kopiyan nod puung atag koddi, ko‑ilangan nod dumoruma koddi. Na ahad ingkon a, diyon en mandad sikandin, woy dos ahad ondoy nod puung atag koddi, od posivontuhan taddot Amoy ku.”
Id Ponudtuu Tapoy ni Disas iddos Moka‑atag to Kopotayan Din

Na ponayun mid ikahi si Disas to, “Ko‑ungkay, oray'n naaggow kos ginawa ku. Ondan ayu kos od dosalon ku? Od buyuwon ku vo riyot Amoy ku no id poleggua a nikandin pomon ka‑ay'n koosayan? Konna, su ini en kos unayan nid undini a to ingod amoy od ko‑ukitan ku idda.”

Na mid dasaa si Disas diyot Amoy rin, kahi rin to, “Amoy ku, povontuhow kos ngaran du.” Idda ron en, duwon norinog dan no bawos pomon diyot datas to langit no mid ungketen to, “Id povantug kud en woy'd povontuhon ku en mandon ini.”
To norinog idda taddot mo‑uraan minuvu rutun, mid ikahi sikandan to, “Eh, id louhung.” Dos duma, mid ungketen to, “Duwon ponolihan no id oseng kandin.”
Piru mid ikahi si Disas to, “Iddon bawos, konna atag koddi, ko konna, atag en koniyu amoy'd pomakoy kow.
Ini ron en kos timpu to kodhukum to Monama taddot mgo minuvu ka‑ay to ampow't ingod. Woy ini ron en kos timpu nod kotalu ron si Moivuyan no ponguu to mgo minuvu no diid pomakoy.
Piru siyak, otik id pakpak ad woy id poratas diyon to krus, od poporoniyon ku ka‑ay't koddi iddos langun no minuvu.”
Id oseng din idda, su amoy id posaddoo rin ko momonnu sikandin od patoy.

Na mid ikahi kandin iddos mo‑uraan minuvu to, “Diyot mgo Suhu ni Moises, novasa roy no diid patoy iddos Mesiyas. De‑en mambot od oseng ka no ko‑ilangan id pakpak woy id poratas diyon to krus iddos Anak to Minuvu? Ondoy man bos kos Anak to Minuvu?”

Kahin Disas to, “Diid kouhoy, od kowora ron iddos ko‑owangan ka‑ay't koniyu. De‑en ipanow kow riyot ko‑owangan laggun to duma pa ini koniyu amoy dii kow od koso‑utan to mosukirom. Su iddos od ipanow riyot mosukirom, waa saddoo rin ko ingkon sikandin od undiyon.
Purisu laggun to ka‑ay pa kos ko‑owangan, ko‑ilangan nod pomakoy kow amoy'd kosakup kow tadda.” Nopongnga rin osenga idda, id tanan don sikandin woy worad id pokita kandan.
Waa id Pomakoy ki Disas iddos mgo Ponguu to Judio
Na, ahad nokita ron en taddot mgo ponguu to Judio iddos mo‑uraan mokososoobbun pinuungan ni Disas, waa sikandan id pomakoy kandin.
De‑en notuman iddos id ikahi ni propeta Isaias no mid ungketen to,

content.text: “Longaggon, waa od pomakoy to ponudtulon doy.
Waa minuvun nokaabbot taddot kotuusan no id pokita ru kandan.”

content: Duwon mandad id oseng ni Isaias moka‑atag to unayan no dii ran od pokopomakoy. Kahi rin to,

content.text: “Id sobpongngan to Monama kos mata ran amoy dii ran od pokokita,
woy id potoggas din kos pusung dan amoy dii ran od pokaabbot.
Id puungan to Monama idda amoy dii sikandan od pokoporani kandin
woy amoy diid koposinsyan kos mgo saa ran.”

content: Na, si Disas iddos od tommanon ni Isaias to id oseng din ini, su nokita rin don tapoy no od posivontuhan en sikandin.

Ahad iling tadda, mo‑uraa rad no mgo ponguu to Judio kos mid pomakoy ki Disas. Piru pomon to allak dan to mgo Pariseo, waa ran ini id ponudtuu, su saddook od po‑owan sikandan woy dii ron od poko‑usok diyot simba‑an to mgo Judio.
Oyyos iyon dan id dokollan to ginawa, iddos koddoong to mgo minuvu kandan lampas pa taddot koddoong to Monama.
Na id pehes si Disas no mid ungketen to, “Iddos ahad ondoy nod pomakoy koddi, konna ra siyak kos id pomokayan din, ko konna, idda en mandad so id popiyod koddi.
Su iddos nokokita koddi, nokokita mandad taddot id popiyod koddi.
Mid undini a amoy'd boggoy to ko‑owangan to mgo minuvu ka‑ay to ampow't ingod, su amoy iddos ahad ondoy nod pomakoy koddi, dii ron od ubpa riyot mosukirom.
Dos ahad ondoy no nokorinog to nonaw ku, piru waa rin puungi, konna siyak kos od hukum kandin. Oyyos waa a mid undini amoy'd hukum to mgo minuvu, ko konna, amoy od tobbus kandan.
Duwon en od hukum taddot minuvu no id elle koddi woy diid tanggap to nonaw ku. Su iddos nonaw ku, idda en kos od hukum kandin init morin allow.
Oyyos waa a mid nonaw pomon to koddin id kopi‑i, ko konna, iddos Amoy ku no id popiyod koddi kos id nonaw ko ondan kos od osengon ku.
Purisu iddos id ponudtuu ku koniyu, idda ra en so id po‑ikahi koddi to Amoy ku. Oyya su nosorollan ku no iddos nonaw rin, od undag en to umuun waad tomanon.”

footnotes.text: Otik diyot Griego no kinohiyan, otollun gatus no denario.Dos koru‑anon tadda, lampas pa to sokkad no lahun no bayad to kod‑urunaa.
Diyot botasanon to mgo Judio, od dihuson dan to pomammut kos lawa to minatoy to dii pa id lobbong.
Inis palmera, od poko‑iling to moman, piru moollimot da kos lokkoy ka‑ay.
Inis Sion, osson ngaran to Jerusalem.
